basic_details.job_title: KUDSIT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for AI Developer, Junior AI Developer Posts
basic_details.short_information: Kerala University of Digital Sciences Innovation and Technology (KUDSIT) has announced 4 vacancies for AI Developer and Junior AI Developer posts on a contract basis for 1 year, extendable based on performance and project requirement. The notified pay is Rs. 35,000-40,000 per month for the AI Developer post and Rs. 20,000-25,000 per month for the Junior AI Developer post, with qualification requirements including B.Tech, BE, M.Tech, MSc, or MCA in relevant disciplines. content_sections.heading: KUDSIT AI Developer at a Glance

rows.details: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology (Digital University Kerala)
Centre for Excellence on Judicial Intelligence
1 year (extendable based on performance and project requirement)
AI Developer and Junior AI Developer
Rs. 35,000-40,000 per month (AI Developer); Rs. 20,000-25,000 per month (Junior AI Developer)
Not exceed 35 years (AI Developer) and 30 years (Junior AI Developer) as on last date

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a B.Tech / BE / M.Tech / MSc in Information Technology / Computer Science / Data Science / MCA from a recognized Institution or University. Essential Experience for AI Developer: For M.Tech holders with a specialisation in AI/ML, minimum experience is not required, provided their thesis or project work is on designing or developing AI/ML/Language models. For all others, a minimum of 1 year of post-qualification experience in developing and deploying AI/ML models in real-world applications is required. Essential Experience for Junior AI Developer: 0 to 1 year of post-qualification experience in developing and deploying AI/ML models in real-world applications. Desirable Skillsets & Experience: Familiarity with machine learning and deep learning models (e.g., TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch). Experience working with SQL DBMS like PostgreSQL and NoSQL DB. Basic data structures and algorithms (sorting, searching), logical and analytical thinking, and the ability to analyse and solve programming problems using Python. Preference is given to candidates with experience in NLP and OCR.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Appointments are made on a contract basis for a period of 1 year under the Centre for Excellence on Judicial Intelligence funded by the State Government. The term may be extended further based on candidate performance and project requirements. Remuneration is consolidated and determined based on experience and qualifications.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KUDSIT AI Developer
content_sections.text: Access the recruitment portal at the official website link: https://www.duk.ac.in/careers. Fill out the online application form with all required details. Upload scanned copies of documents proving age, educational qualifications, and experience. Submit the application online latest by 27.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process will be based on a test and/or interview. The test and interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only. Candidates will be informed of the schedule through their registered email.

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointments are on a contract basis for 1 year, and the term may be extended further based on performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit should not exceed 35 years for the AI Developer post and 30 years for the Junior AI Developer post as on the last date fixed for application submission.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any age relaxation available?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 5 years for candidates belonging to SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications online is 27.10.2026.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the test or interview take place?
faq.answer: The test and interview will be conducted in Thiruvananthapuram district only.
